games.description: Sark investigates the Crimson Motel alone, reading its case notes, opening briefcases for VHS tapes, and filming the haunted rooms. The investigation ends amid stalled progress and computer-interface problems.
games.title: Death Motel

games.description: Two solo journeys through the killer-car city, following payphones and piecing together the family story. Sark completes the first route, then returns in New Game Plus for more dangerous vehicles and the final truck chase.
games.title: Decimate Drive

games.description: Three solo blocks through an abandoned Chinese school. Sark deciphers its puzzles, endures repeated resets, finds grandma’s gift and finally defeats the Black Mountain Demon before the musical epilogue.
